title: The fearless Hanuma
introduction: Hanuma, the Marvellous Monkey of Ramayana is entered in this chapter. The very first assurance given by Sage Valmiki through Hanuma, to one and all is, "Be Fearless..." Even today that assurance of Hanuma is ruling high on the Hindu psyche and Hanuma is to be remembered in any event of fright.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्दे द्वितीयः सर्गः ||
Thus, this is the 2nd chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana,the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महात्मानौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ |
वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ सुग्रीवः श्ङ्कितोऽभवत्
verses.iast:
tau tu dṛṣṭvā mahātmānau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau |
vara āyudha dharau vīrau sugrīvaḥ śñkito'bhavat
verses.translation: On seeing them the wielders of best weapons and audacious ones, two brothers and great souls, namely Rama and Lakshmana, Sugreeva became ambiguous.

glosses.itrans: vara aayudha dhara viirau mahaatmanau bhraatarau
glosses.iast: vara āyudha dhara vīrau mahātmanau bhrātarau
glosses.devanagari: वर आयुध धर वीरौ महात्मनौ भ्रातरौ
glosses.meaning: best, weapons, wielders, audacious ones, great souls, the two brothersm - Rama and Lakshmana

verses.devanagari:
उद्विग्न हृदयः सर्वा दिशः समवलोकयन् |
न व्यतिष्ठत कस्मिन् चित् देशे वानर पुङ्गवः
verses.iast:
udvigna hṛdayaḥ sarvā diśaḥ samavalokayan |
na vyatiṣṭhata kasmin cit deśe vānara puñgavaḥ
verses.translation: Distressed at heart that foremost monkey gazed blankly in all directions and he did not remain at any one place.

verses.devanagari:
नैव चक्रे मनः स्थातुम् वीक्षमाणो महाबलौ |
कपेः परम भीतस्य चित्तम् व्यवससाद ह
verses.iast:
naiva cakre manaḥ sthātum vīkṣamāṇo mahābalau |
kapeḥ parama bhītasya cittam vyavasasāda ha
verses.translation: On seeing those two great mighty ones that monkey has not even made-up his mind steadfast as he is very much frightened, and his heart is really sunken.

glosses.meaning: on seeing, the great mighty ones
not, even, made-up, his mind, steadfast

verses.devanagari:
चिन्तयित्वा स धर्मात्मा विमृश्य गुरु लाघवम् |
सुग्रीवः परम उद्विग्नः सर्वैः तैः वानरैः सह
verses.iast:
cintayitvā sa dharmātmā vimṛśya guru lāghavam |
sugrīvaḥ parama udvignaḥ sarvaiḥ taiḥ vānaraiḥ saha
verses.translation: He that righteous Sugreeva considering his own strength and weakness is much agitated, and along with all the other monkeys too are frightened.

glosses.meaning: considering, [about his own] strength and weakness
with all, those, monkeys, along with.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स सचिवेभ्यः तु सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः |
शशंस परम उद्विग्नः पश्यन् तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa sacivebhyaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ |
śaśaṃsa parama udvignaḥ paśyan tau rāma lakṣmaṇau
verses.translation: On seeing Rama and Lakshmana then that chief of monkeys Sugreeva with much dreadfulness said this to his ministers.

glosses.meaning: then, he, to his ministers, even
on seeing, those, Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
एतौ वनम् इदम् दुर्गम् वालि प्रणिहितौ ध्रुवम् |
छद्मना चीर वसनौ प्रचरन्तौ इह आगतौ
verses.iast:
etau vanam idam durgam vāli praṇihitau dhruvam |
chadmanā cīra vasanau pracarantau iha āgatau
verses.translation: "Here they come wearing jute cloths and move about in this impassable forest deceitfully, definitely Vali must have dispatched them...

glosses.meaning: this, in forest, impassable one, moving about

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुग्रीव सचिवा दृष्ट्वा परम धन्विनौ |
जग्मुः गिरि तटात् तस्माद् अन्यत् शिखरम् उत्तमम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sugrīva sacivā dṛṣṭvā parama dhanvinau |
jagmuḥ giri taṭāt tasmād anyat śikharam uttamam
verses.translation: Then on seeing the great archers Rama and Lakshmana the ministers of Sugreeva have gone from that mountain terrace to another high-peaked mountain.

verses.devanagari:
ते क्षिप्रम् अभिगम्य अथ यूथपा यूथपर्षभम् |
हरयो वानर श्रेष्ठम् परिवार्य उपतस्थिरे
verses.iast:
te kṣipram abhigamya atha yūthapā yūthaparṣabham |
harayo vānara śreṣṭham parivārya upatasthire
verses.translation: Then the group-leaders of monkeys quickly arrived as they fled, at that lofty monkey group-leader Sugreeva, the chieftain of monkeys, gathering around him there they stood at his nearby.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् एक आयन गताः प्लवमाना गिरेः गिरिम् |
प्रकंपयन्तो वेगेन गिरीणाम् शिखराणि च
verses.iast:
evam eka āyana gatāḥ plavamānā gireḥ girim |
prakampayanto vegena girīṇām śikharāṇi ca
verses.translation: Thus they reached to one course of return, after hopping from one mountain to the other, shuddering mountains and even thir peaks by their trample in hastiness.

glosses.meaning: thus, to one, course, reached out

verses.devanagari:
ततः शाखा मृगाः सर्वे प्लवमाना महाबलाः |
बभंजुः च नगान् तत्र पुष्पितान् दुर्गम् आश्रितान्
verses.iast:
tataḥ śākhā mṛgāḥ sarve plavamānā mahābalāḥ |
babhaṃjuḥ ca nagān tatra puṣpitān durgam āśritān
verses.translation: Then all of the tree-branch animals, who are great in their strength, have wrecked down the well-flowered trees that are clumped in that forest on that mountain by their swinging.

verses.devanagari:
आप्लवन्तो हरिवराः सर्वतः तम् महागिरिम् |
मृग मार्जार शार्दूलान् त्रासयन्तो ययुः तदा
verses.iast:
āplavanto harivarāḥ sarvataḥ tam mahāgirim |
mṛga mārjāra śārdūlān trāsayanto yayuḥ tadā
verses.translation: While those best monkeys hopped everywhere they have frightened deer, wildcats and tigers on that great mountain.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुग्रीव सचिवाः पर्वतेन्द्रे समाहिताः |
संगम्य कपि मुख्येन सर्वे प्रांजलयः स्थिताः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sugrīva sacivāḥ parvatendre samāhitāḥ |
saṅgamya kapi mukhyena sarve prāṃjalayaḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Then the ministers of Sugreeva, assembled on that best mountain and gathered around the chief of monkeys Sugreeva, and all stood with their adjoined palms.

glosses.meaning: on the mountain, the best, on assembling

verses.devanagari:
ततः तु भय संत्रस्तम् वालि किल्बिष शन्कितम् |
उवाच हनुमान् वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् वाक्य कोविदः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tu bhaya santrastam vāli kilbiṣa śankitam |
uvāca hanumān vākyam sugrīvam vākya kovidaḥ
verses.translation: Then Hanuma, the ablest sentence-maker, said this sentence to Sugreeva who is dismayed with fear doubting Vali's mischief.

verses.devanagari:
संभ्रमः त्यजताम् एष सर्वैः वालि कृते महान् |
मलयोऽयम् गिरिवरो भयम् न इह अस्ति वालिनः
verses.iast:
sambhramaḥ tyajatAm eṣa sarvaiḥ vAli kṛte mahān |
malayo'yam girivaro bhayam na iha asti vālinaḥ
verses.translation: "Perplexity be warded off... all of you discarded that great fear from Vali or his cruelty... there is no scare from Vali here on this best mountain, for it is Mt. Malaya...
notes: This opening assurance by Hanuma to 'ward off any perplexity...' may be noticed. These statements and deeds are befitting to the fame of Hanuma to ward off any evil force. The sanctity of this mountain and a no-entry to Vali at this place is explained in next few chapters. This vāli kṛtaḥ and vālikṛte are two renderings, where, valikṛtaḥ is in the present context is for the arrival of Rama and Lakshmana, and vālikṛte, is for that which Vali has done previously. In either case, there is no fear on this Mt. Rishyamuka or also called Mt. Malaya, because Vali cannot step on this mountain due to a curse.

glosses.meaning: Malaya mountain, this one, mountain, the best

verses.devanagari:
यस्मात् उद्विग्न चेताः त्वम् विद्रुतो हरिपुंगव |
तम् क्रूर दर्शनम् क्रूरम् न इह पश्यामि वालिनम्
verses.iast:
yasmāt udvigna cetāḥ tvam vidruto haripuṃgava |
tam krūra darśanam krūram na iha paśyāmi vālinam
verses.translation: "By whom you are bewildered at heart and running away, oh, the best monkey Sugreeva, I do not see that cruel-looking, cruel Vali here...

glosses.meaning: you, by whom, bewildered, at heart
ferocious one for sight, atrocious one, Vali

verses.devanagari:
यस्मात् तव भयम् सौम्य पूर्वजात् पाप कर्मणः |
स न इह वाली दुष्टात्मा न ते पश्यामि अहम् भयम्
verses.iast:
yasmāt tava bhayam saumya pūrvajāt pāpa karmaṇaḥ |
sa na iha vālī duṣṭātmā na te paśyāmi aham bhayam
verses.translation: "From whom your fear is spurted, oh, gentle Sugreeva, that elder brother of yours, who is an evildoer and the one with harmful intent... that Vali is not here. Therefore I perceive no fear from him...

glosses.meaning: not, by him, perceive, I, fear.

verses.devanagari:
अहो शाखा मृगत्वम् ते व्यक्तम् एव प्लवंगम |
लघु चित्ततया आत्मानम् न स्थापयसि यो मतौ
verses.iast:
aho śākhā mṛgatvam te vyaktam eva plavaṃgama |
laghu cittatayā ātmānam na sthāpayasi yo matau
verses.translation: "Aha! You made a monkey of yourself, oh, monkey, and you feel small, thus you are not able to stay firm in your mind by that fickleness, and your monkeyshines is clear by it...

glosses.meaning: not, able to stay firm in mind

verses.devanagari:
बुद्धि विज्ञान संपन्न इङ्गितैः सर्वम् आचर |
न हि अबुद्धिम् गतो राजा सर्व भूतानि शास्ति हि
verses.iast:
buddhi viGYāna sampanna iñgitaiḥ sarvam ācara |
na hi abuddhim gato rājā sarva bhūtāni śāsti hi
verses.translation: "Keep your intellect and wisdom firm, and express all your intents rightly in your body language in all your undertakings... certainly, a king getting into unintelligence cannot command all his subjects..." So said Hanuma to Sugreeva.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवः तु शुभम् वाक्यम् श्रुत्वा सर्वम् हनूमतः |
ततः शुभतरम् वाक्यम् हनूमन्तम् उवाच ह
verses.iast:
sugrīvaḥ tu śubham vākyam śrutvā sarvam hanūmataḥ |
tataḥ śubhataram vākyam hanūmantam uvāca ha
verses.translation: Sugreeva thus hearing entirely to all the propitious words of Hanuma spoke to Hanuma this opportune sentence, positively.

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घ बाहू विशालाक्षौ शर चाप असि धारिणौ |
कस्य न स्यात् भयम् दृष्ट्वा हि एतौ सुर सुत उपमौ
verses.iast:
dīrgha bāhū viśālākṣau śara cāpa asi dhāriṇau |
kasya na syāt bhayam dṛṣṭvā hi etau sura suta upamau
verses.translation: "Lengthy are their arms, broad are their eyes and they are the wielders of arrows, bows and swords... and on seeing them, to whom there will be no scare? These two are like the sons of some divinity..." Sugreeva thus spoke to Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: to whom, will not, be there, scare

verses.devanagari:
वालि प्रणिहितौ एव शन्के अहम् पुरुषोत्तमौ |
राजानो बहु मित्राः च विश्वासो न अत्र हि क्षमः
verses.iast:
vāli praṇihitau eva śanke aham puruṣottamau |
rājāno bahu mitrāḥ ca viśvāso na atra hi kṣamaḥ
verses.translation: "I presume these two... those best of men are abetted by Vali to assault me... for, the kings like Vali do have many friends and trusting them absolutely is an unpardonable mistake...

verses.devanagari:
अरयः च मनुष्येण विज्ञेयाः छद्म चारिणः |
विश्वस्तानाम् अविश्वस्ताः छिद्रेषु प्रहरन्ति अपि
verses.iast:
arayaḥ ca manuṣyeṇa viGYeyāḥ chadma cāriṇaḥ |
viśvastānām aviśvastāḥ chidreṣu praharanti api
verses.translation: "By men the enemies are to be assessed... for, they move in disguise and distrustful enemies will trounce the complacently self-assured ones that relax in their own self-confidence on any possible occasion...

glosses.meaning: enemies, also, by men, to be assessed

verses.devanagari:
कृत्येषु वाली मेधावी राजानो बहु दर्शनः |
भवन्ति पर हन्तारः ते ज्ञेयाः प्राकृतैः नरैः
verses.iast:
kṛtyeṣu vālī medhāvī rājāno bahu darśanaḥ |
bhavanti para hantāraḥ te GYeyāḥ prākṛtaiḥ naraiḥ
verses.translation: "In exploits Vali is an ingenious one... and the kings will be observing many aspects of their enemies to eliminate them... and they the kings are to be known even by ordinary people...

glosses.meaning: they will be, others [enemies,] eliminators of

verses.devanagari:
तौ त्वया प्राकृतेन एव गत्वा ज्ञेयौ प्लवंगम |
इङ्गितानाम् प्रकारैः च रूपव्या भाषणेन च
verses.iast:
tau tvayā prākṛtena eva gatvā GYeyau plavaṅgama |
iñgitānām prakāraiḥ ca rūpavyā bhāṣaṇena ca
verses.translation: "Begone to them oh, monkey Hanuma, in a commoner's form, for your monkey-hood is distinguishable by Vali's agents, and know the intentions of those two by their conduct, by their semblance, and by their conversation, as well...

glosses.meaning: by you, in commoner's form [undistinguished form] alone, on going

verses.devanagari:
लक्षयस्व तयोः भावम् प्रहृष्ट मनसौ यदि |
विश्वासयन् प्रशंसाभिः इङ्गितैः च पुनः पुनः
मम एव अभिमुखम् स्थित्वा पृच्छ त्वम् हरि पुंगव |
प्रयोजनम् प्रवेशस्य वनस्य अस्य धनुर् धरौ
verses.iast:
lakṣayasva tayoḥ bhāvam prahṛṣṭa manasau yadi |
viśvāsayan praśaṃsābhiḥ iñgitaiḥ ca punaḥ punaḥ
mama eva abhimukham sthitvā pṛccha tvam hari puṅgava |
prayojanam praveśasya vanasya asya dhanur dharau
verses.translation: "Aim at their concepts and if they are pleasant-hearted, duly create confidence in them by conducting yourself, and also commending them again and again... oh, best of monkeys, Hanuma, set their face towards me alone in a compassionate manner, and you inquire about the reason of their entering this forest alone... of those bows wielders...
notes: For this prahṛṣṭa manau yadi, this is said to be the text of Govindaraja, whereas the still ancient manuscripts read this as duṣṭa manasau yadi, evil-minded if... because Sugreeva's suspicion is not yet ameliorated, and he still views them as evildoers. For the first compound, mama abhimukham eva sthitvā some said the meaning that Hanuma should stand with his face facing Sugreeva while talking to Rama and Lakshmana. Sugreeva is now on Mt. Rishyamuka and Rama is somewhere at a distant place to where Hanuma takes a flight later. Then keeping Hanuma's face towards Sugreeva, rather than towards Rama and Lakshmana, is appearing to be an uncomfortable position. For this some old translations say, śitvā keep them, position them towards my friendship and me.

glosses.meaning: to me, companionate, alone, facing them
in this, forest, entrance's, purposefulness [what is]

verses.devanagari:
शुद्ध आत्मानौ यदि एतौ जानीहि त्वम् प्लवंगम |
व्याभाषितैः वा रूपैः वा विज्ञेया दुष्टता अनयोः
verses.iast:
śuddha ātmānau yadi etau jānīhi tvam plavaṅgama |
vyābhāṣitaiḥ vā rūpaiḥ vā viGYeyā duṣṭatā anayoḥ
verses.translation: "You shall know whether those two are clean at heart or otherwise, or about their evil-mindedness or otherwise by conversation..." Thus Sugreeva said to Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: these two, clean, at heart, if

verses.devanagari:
इति एवम् कपिराजेन संदिष्टो मारुतात्मजः |
चकार गमने बुद्धिम् यत्र तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
verses.iast:
iti evam kapirājena saṃdiṣṭo mārutātmajaḥ |
cakāra gamane buddhim yatra tau rāma lakṣmaṇau
verses.translation: Thus this way ordered by Sugreeva, the king of monkeys, Hanuma, the son of Air-god made up his mind to go there, where Rama and Lakshmana are.

glosses.meaning: thus, this way, by monkeys king, ordered
where, those two, Rama and Lakshmana [are there.]

verses.devanagari:
तथा इति संपूज्य वचः तु तस्य
कपेः सुभीतस्य दुरासदस्य |
महानुभावो हनुमान् ययौ तदा
स यत्र रामो अतिबली स लक्ष्मणः
verses.iast:
tathā iti sampūjya vacaḥ tu tasya
kapeḥ subhītasya durāsadasya |
mahānubhāvo hanumān yayau tadā
sa yatra rāmo atibalī sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: That marvellous monkey Hanuma agreeing for the words of that inaccessible and very much frightened Sugreeva, and on respectfully replying him saying that, 'I will do accordingly...' proceeded there where that highly mighty Rama is there along with Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: his, words, like that [I will do,] thus

glosses.itrans: ati balii sa lakshmaNaH saH raamaH
glosses.iast: ati balī sa lakśmaṇaḥ saḥ rāmaḥ
glosses.devanagari: अति बली स लक्श्मणः सः रामः
glosses.meaning: highly mighty one, he, who is with Lakshmana
